The 2003 Formula 1 drivers' championship was won by Michael Schumacher, driving for Ferrari. He finished with 93 points and 6 wins, ahead of Kimi Räikkönen (91 points) and Juan Pablo Montoya (82 points). Ferrari also took the constructors' title.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
